title: Graph neural network screening identifies carvedilol as a THRb partial agonist
summary: Carvedilol was identified as a partial THRb agonist and lowered lipid and triglycerides in cells, shown by TR-FRET and cellular assays. Docking and MM-GBSA were also used; evidence is in vitro only.
ai_technology: Graph neural network virtual screening of an in-house library

evidence.unknown: Abstract only; docking/MM-GBSA also used; in vitro only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: GNN virtual screening prioritised THRb agonists from in-house library

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
